# The outside-parent dialog of button 442 (SelectNavDlgProc): a bone of
# chain8 attached to a bone of lips (630), the dialog's records saved into
# the model as a display key (632), then the same bone on the ground. A
# close without 630 or 632 does not seek the model.
load model .\lips.pmd
load model chain8.pmx
frame 10
outside parent open
dialog select 669 1
dialog select 673 2
dialog select 677 3
dialog click 630
dialog click 632
dialog cancel
save pmm attached.pmm

frame 20
outside parent open
dialog select 669 1
dialog select 673 1
dialog click 630
dialog click 632
dialog cancel
save pmm ground.pmm

frame 30
outside parent open
dialog select 669 2
dialog select 673 2
dialog cancel
save pmm closed.pmm
